name: the language
headline: The *language* of Hypercomb
say: Hypercomb has its own language, and each word is exact. A hive is where you and your people meet. A tile is one cell of content. A layer is one moment of a place, kept for good. A signature is the name the content gives itself. A bee, short for beehavior, senses when it is needed, then acts. A pheromone is an interest someone leaves on a tile, so it can find the people who share it. Replication is how work crosses between hives, checked byte by byte. Brooding and eclosion are how a tile is prepared, then hatches onto your screen. And the colony is the whole of it: many hives, and no central authority.
